purpose: The approved loam and granite artwork for the terrain arena (epic #636, TRA-8), copied byte for byte from Synarchy. Authored content for the later arena assembly; no engine library names it and nothing reads it at run time from Synarchy.

source.repository: Synarchy (the owner's local checkout, ~/work/synarchy; no runtime or build dependency on it)

assets.name: loam
assets.treatment: colour data, sRGB; binary alpha (0 or 255)

assets.name: granite
assets.treatment: colour data, sRGB; binary alpha (0 or 255)

mapping: Synarchy refers to these as mat_tile_56 (loam) and mat_tile_1 (granite) in scripts/test_arena.lua:117-133. Those references are recorded here only; they are not packed terrain palette indices and no engine constant. The authored material names are loam and granite.

referenceSilhouettes.catalog: src/World/Render/Textures.hs:23-57 maps the 16 world shape identities to the isoface / isoface_slope_* face-map images under assets/textures/facemap/. They are reference evidence for the silhouettes only; the shared solid geometry of hetoimasia-terrain and the TRA-7 coverage are authoritative. No face-map image is retained in this repository.
